title: Use named keys
summary: Dart: Use named keys. Look up the pages key.
introduction: A Map pairs keys and values. It can find a value by a text label.

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.

blocks.title: Use named keys

blocks.text: The title key selects one value from the Map: Moon Trip.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A missing map key gives null.
